# att.Ryokan & Resorts

> > A curated collection of premium Japanese ryokan, onsen resorts, and traditional accommodations across Japan, featuring kaiseki dining, hot spring experiences, and cultural immersion.

att.Ryokan & Resorts showcases luxury traditional Japanese inns and resorts throughout regions including Hokuriku, Tohoku, Kanto, Kansai, and Kyushu. The site emphasizes authentic onsen experiences, regional cuisine, and cultural heritage at destinations like Kusatsu Onsen, Hakone, Beppu, and historic hot spring towns.

## Key Topics

- Onsen (Japanese hot springs)
- Ryokan (traditional Japanese inns)
- Kaiseki dining
- Hokuriku region (Ishikawa, Fukui)
- Tohoku region
- Kanto region (Hakone, Kusatsu)
- Luxury accommodation
- Hot spring resorts
- Traditional Japanese crafts
- Private bath experiences
- Ocean-view onsen
- French-Japanese fusion cuisine
- Temple lodging (shukubo)
- Cultural immersion experiences

## Premium Onsen Resorts

- [別府温泉 | Beppu Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/kyushu/beppuonsen): Beppu Onsen hot spring resort in Oita, featuring Beppu Hatto & jigoku
- [南紀白浜温泉 | Nankishirahama Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/kansai/nankishirahamaonsen): Nankishirahama Onsen beach resort in Wakayama, one of Japan's top 3
- [那須温泉 | Nasu Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/kanto/nasuonsen): Nasu Onsen highland resort in Tochigi with 1300+ year history
- [山中温泉 | Yamanaka Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/hokuriku/yamanakaonsen): Yamanaka Onsen in Ishikawa, discovered 1300 years ago, visited by Basho
- [秋保温泉 | Akiu Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/tohoku/%e7%a7%8b%e4%bf%9d%e6%b8%a9%e6%b3%89): Akiu Onsen in Miyagi, 1500-year-old hot spring resort near Sendai
- [黄金崎不老ふ死温泉 | Furofushi Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/tohoku/furofushionsen): Furofushi Onsen in Aomori with ocean-view seaside outdoor bath

## Traditional Ryokan Experiences

- [界 加賀 | Kai Kaga](https://att-ryokan.net/hokuriku/kai_kaga): Kai Kaga ryokan in Yamashiro Onsen with Kaga crafts & traditional culture
- [陽気館 | Yokikan](https://att-ryokan.net/tokai/yokikan): Yokikan ryokan in Ito with cable car to ocean-view onsen & Izu cuisine
- [湯けむりの宿 稲住温泉 | Inazumi Onsen](https://att-ryokan.net/tohoku/yukemuri-no-yado-inazumi-onsen): Inazumi Onsen historic ryokan in Akita's oldest Akinomiya hot spring area
- [湯けむりの宿　雪の花 | Yuki no Hana](https://att-ryokan.net/koshinetsu/niigata/yuki-no-hana): Yuki no Hana in Echigo Yuzawa, setting of Kawabata's 'Snow Country'
- [永平寺　親禅の宿　柏樹關 | Hakujukan Eiheiji](https://att-ryokan.net/hokuriku/hakujukan-eiheiji): Hakujukan Eiheiji temple lodging in Fukui with zazen & shojin cuisine

## Hakone & Kanto Region

- [ホテルマロウド箱根 | Hotel Marroad Hakone](https://att-ryokan.net/kanto/hotel-marroad-hakone): Hotel Marroad Hakone in Gora Onsen with French cuisine & Owakudani spring
- [はつはな | Hatsuhana](https://att-ryokan.net/kanto/hotelhatsuhana): Hatsuhana in Hakone Yumoto with private outdoor baths & modern kaiseki
- [お宿 木の葉 | Oyado Konoha](https://att-ryokan.net/kanto/oyado-konoha): Oyado Konoha in Kusatsu Onsen with dual-source hot springs & sauna

## Tohoku Region Retreats

- [会津芦ノ牧温泉　大川荘 | Ookawaso](https://att-ryokan.net/tohoku/ookawaso): Ookawaso in Aizu with terraced outdoor baths overlooking Okawa gorge

## Hokuriku Cultural Stays

- [ザ・スクエアホテル金沢 | The Square Hotel Kanazawa](https://att-ryokan.net/hokuriku/the-square-hotel-kanazawa): The Square Hotel Kanazawa with Kaga-goshiki design & Ishikawa cuisine

## Specialty & Resort Properties

- [ルシアン旧軽井沢 | Le Chien Kyukaruizawa](https://att-ryokan.net/koshinetsu/nagano/le-chien-kyukaruizawa): Le Chien pet-friendly resort in Karuizawa with dog run & French cuisine
